Absent-registry qualification below is essential.

Published tagless piece b wins live while explicit-video c wins historical tags-only policy; regional contribution0.4 and actual driver match. Default diversity/order stays equal to historical output; no-learning, lifecycle/window/stock/slot and pin controls remain. Actual queue→ledger serialization/readback/replay preserves both records, independent pin/exploration combinations, absent markers/manifests and strict malformed-marker refusal. Existing coupled replay/external-term exact assertions retain their arithmetic.

Exact admitted selection executed independently once on frozen bytes:14 passed,89 unselected,exit0/drained. Complete worker evidence and failure history inspected; final compiler/lint/whitespace reused. All46 pins,27 protected dependencies and13 exact forward/reverse deltas match before/after; artifact/contract remain the registered verification identities. No expanded suite, static rerun or source change.
